## AutomatorActionResourceClient.list() method

List the automator actions of one workflow, as one page. When several workflows share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used as the workflow.

**Signature:**

```typescript
list(workflowName: string, __mactsOptions?: _macts_contracts.CallOptions): Promise<Page<AutomatorAction>>;
```
